subject: Political Science / Civics (Nagrik Shastra / Rajneeti Shastra)

marks_structure.extra_time_note: Haan — 15 minute reading time milta hai. Is time mein paper padho, OR options mein se kaunsa attempt karoge decide karo, aur 250-word long answers ka outline soch lo.

paper_overview.sets_note: UP Board mein multiple sets hote hain (e.g., 323 ES in 2024). Har set mein same questions, order alag.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono allowed. Question paper bilingual aata hai (323 ES = English/Hindi set).
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Internal choice (OR option) sirf Q31 aur Q32 mein milta hai — dono Long Answer questions mein.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: UP Board Political Science ka syllabus NCERT par based hai — 'Contemporary World Politics' (Part A) aur 'Politics in India since Independence' (Part B). Dono NCERT books sab chapters solve karo. Previous year papers (PYQ) 2018-2025 se revision zaroor karo.

question_types_in_exam.summary: UP Board Class 12 Political Science mein 5 types ke questions: MCQ (1), VSA (2), SA-I (5), SA-II (6), LA (8). Total = 100 marks, 32 questions.

types.how_to_attempt: Correct option answer-book mein likhna. Explanation ki zaroorat nahi.
types.mostly_from: Dates, leaders' names, organization founding years, treaties, constitutional articles, country-event match, basic definitions.

types.type: Very Short Answer (VSA / Ati Laghu Uttareeya)
types.how_to_attempt: Do factual points likhna — jaise 'do desh ke naam', 'do sansthaon ke naam', 'kab aur kahaan'. Har part 1 mark.
types.mostly_from: List-type questions — two countries, two organizations, two leaders, two reasons, date + place, assassin + year.

types.how_to_attempt: Concept clear karo + 3-4 points + example/date. 5 marks = definition (1) + main points (3) + conclusion/example (1).
types.mostly_from: Causes-consequences questions, brief notes (sankshipt tippani), comparisons, process explanations.

types.how_to_attempt: Introduction (1) + main body with 4-5 points (4) + conclusion (1). Dates, examples, leaders' names zaroor include karo.
types.mostly_from: Process + hindrances, role + relevance, analysis of political events, factors behind success/failure.

types.how_to_attempt: Introduction (1) + Part 1 detailed (3) + Part 2 detailed (3) + examples/dates (0.5) + conclusion with opinion (0.5). Paragraph format mein likho, headings nahi.
types.mostly_from: Foreign policy analysis, Emergency causes+consequences, neighbor relations, regional organizations, Nehru's era.

paper_pattern.note: UP Board Civics theory paper = 100 marks. 32 questions. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes (15 min reading time extra). Bilingual paper (Hindi+English).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Internal choice (OR option) sirf Q31 aur Q32 mein milta hai — dono Long Answer questions mein.

paper_objectives_weightage.note: UP Board blueprint ke hisab se questions inn teen objectives par banaye jaate hain:

knowledge_based.note: Facts, dates, definitions, naam — yaad karne wale questions (MCQ, VSA mein zyada)

understanding_based.note: Concepts samjhana, karan batana, tulna karna (Short Answer I/II mein zyada)

application_based.note: Analysis, evaluation, opinion with justification (Long Answer mein zyada)

paper_difficulty_weightage.note: Board blueprint confirm karta hai — 80% questions easy/normal hote hain. Sirf 20% tough. Agar basic NCERT + PYQ kar liye toh 70+ marks easily aate hain.

important_formula_sheets.note: Not typically applicable for Political Science (humanities subject).

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: Section A (World Politics) aur Section B (Indian Politics) dono equal weightage. Indian Politics thodi tough hoti hai analysis ke liye, World Politics mein facts zyada.

tips: Sare 10 MCQ attempt karo — no negative marking, guessing allowed
VSA 1+1 format wale hote hain — dono parts ka answer do, half credit mat miss karo
Unit 3 (Globalization/Environment) = sabse easy, almost guaranteed scoring
Long Answer (Q31/32) mein dono parts (4+4) attempt karo, ek bhi chhodna mat
Dates aur leaders' naam ki list alag banao — direct MCQ+VSA mein aate hain
Emergency (1975) ka topic har saal LA ya SA-II mein aata hai — zaroor prepare karo
Foreign policy topic LA mein common — Nehru+NAM+Panchsheel+1962 yaad karo
Hinglish chalega — Hindi ya English dono mein likh sakte ho, mix bhi allowed
Previous year papers (2018-2025) zaroor solve karo — pattern same rehta hai
Word limit paar karne se marks cut nahi, par time waste hota hai — approximately rakho
Diagrams ya flowcharts banao jahan possible (foreign relations timeline, coalition politics)
Answer numbering clear rakhna — Q no. + roman numeral (i), (ii) parts ke liye

time_allocation.note: Paper padho, 32 questions scan karo. LA (Q31, Q32) ke OR options mein se easier choose kar lo. SA-II ke topics dekh lo.
10 MCQ × 1.5 min. Seedha option likhna hai. Doubt ho toh bhi answer do — no negative marking.
10 VSA × 2.5 min. 1-line answers, 1+1 format usually. Dates aur naam clearly.
6 questions × 8 min. 50 shabd, 5-7 lines. Concept + 3-4 points + example.
4 questions × 12 min. 100-125 shabd. 3+3 split. Points ko paragraph format mein likho.
2 questions × 20 min. 250 shabd each. Intro + body + conclusion. Choose OR wisely.
Question numbers check karo, dates verify, spelling of names (foreign leaders!), page numbers clear.

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 15 minute reading time milta hai — is time mein sirf paper padho, answers likhna nahi.

answer_sheet_rules: reading_time_note: 15 minute reading time mein sirf paper padho — likhna nahi.
sequence_note: Questions kisi bhi order mein attempt kar sakte ho, bas Q no. clearly likho.
language_rule: Hindi, English, ya Hinglish mein likh sakte ho. Same question ke parts consistent rakho.
mcq_attempt_all: No negative marking — sare 10 MCQ attempt karo
vsa_both_parts: VSA mein 1+1 format ke dono parts attempt karo — half marks lene se better full marks
long_answer_both_parts: LA 8 marks = 4+4. Dono parts attempt karo — ek part chhodne se 4 marks direct cut

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: Sirf maps/diagrams/timeline ke liye. Answers pen se likhna zaroori. note: Red/green pen sirf teachers use karte hain — students ke liye allowed nahi.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: word_limit_strict: False word_limit_note: Word limit approximate hai — 10-15% up/down chalta hai. Par zyada bhi mat likho (time waste). paragraph_format: SA-II aur LA mein paragraph format. Bullet points avoid karo jab tak explicitly na puchha jaaye. headings: Long answers mein sub-headings thik hain — content organized dikhta hai dates_and_names: Dates, proper nouns, country names, treaty names clearly likho — marker ke liye easy ho partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: Incomplete answers par bhi partial marks milte hain — kuch na kuch zaroor likho
